svg.text: Key: artisan oak media wall
v13 · less cladding, stairs up · TV 25 cm nearer the side wall · alcove 186 × 38, ceiling 235 · sizes in cm
OAK JOINERY
Solid oak uprights, 4.5 × 30, worktop to ceiling (159 long)
The left upright is a corner post against the side wall
Flush wedged tenons carry the Series X shelf (134)
High shelf, top 196: books up to 30 cm
Record ledge above the TV: 4 LPs face-out
The ledge wraps the corner: 4 more LPs face-out
LED groove in each upright washes the wall
High shelf, right: the “now playing” 7-inch
ON THE WORKTOP
LG OLED C6 55in · centre 116.5 · now 25 cm nearer the side wall
Soundbar · eARC, optical and AUX inputs
Turntable (AT-LP120X size allowed) · lid clear to 130
Xbox Series X on its fan stand · 15 cm air each side
Phono preamp, hung under the shelf at the back
Solid oak worktop 186 × 46 × 3, top at 76
IN THE ALCOVE BASE
Oak face frame; its bottom rail hides the 9 cm plinth
Xbox One + HDMI switch · its brick flat at the back
Xbox 360 + RetroTINK · its brick flat at the back
Game drawer: 2 face-out bins, spine-up rows behind
PS3 + controller basket · bay 2 top row
PS2 · bay 2, beside the sub
PS1 · under the PS2
Upper record tray: ~90 LPs + ~120 singles · bay 3
Lower record tray: the same, shown pulled out
Hidden slim drawer in the plinth, finger pull
Sub · bay 2, under the TV, on an isolation riser
THE DINING WALL ON THE CHIMNEY BREAST
Oak backboard: lift-off hinges on top, brackets below
Oak table 110 × 80: folded, a plain oiled oak panel
Häfele Hebgo folding brackets, 500 kg a pair
Turn buttons hold the folded table
Two framed LPs above
THE SIDE WALL
PC on its oak shelf, above the end of the sofa (see the room plan)
Brush grommet: the PC's leads drop into the wall
Pad charging dock
PC cables chased into the wall: no spine, no trunking
Keyboard tray under the shelf, rolls out (v6.1)
POWER, NETWORK AND LIGHT
Deco B: leads in the groove behind the right upright
Double socket: its right switch is the retro switch
10-gang extension, hidden behind the TV
LED strip round the ceiling edge (as now)
Spot bar on the existing rose, between TV and sofa
Second spot bar, existing point by the door
Stairs UP to the first floor, beside the door (direction to confirm)
Dashed lines are hidden: gold for data and low-voltage leads, coral for mains.
